diff --git a/command-center/tests/test_terminal_task_paging.py b/command-center/tests/test_terminal_task_paging.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/command-center/tests/test_terminal_task_paging.py
@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+import pytest
+
+from bcc.terminal_cli.cli import list_items
+
+
+class FakeClient:
+    def __init__(self, tasks):
+        self.tasks = sorted(tasks, key=lambda t: t["id"], reverse=True)
+
+    def get(self, path, params=None):
+        assert path == "/api/tasks"
+        params = params or {}
+        limit = params.get("limit", 100)
+        before_id = params.get("before_id")
+        rows = self.tasks
+        if before_id is not None:
+            rows = [t for t in rows if t["id"] < before_id]
+        return rows[:limit]
+
+
+def _task(i):
+    return {"id": i, "status": "done", "title": f"task {i}"}
+
+
+def test_list_tasks_paginates_past_api_cap():
+    tasks = [_task(i) for i in range(1, 838)]
+    client = FakeClient(tasks)
+    rows = list_items(client, "tasks", limit=1000)
+    assert len(rows) == 837
+    assert [r["id"] for r in rows] == list(range(837, 0, -1))
+    assert len({r["id"] for r in rows}) == 837
+
+
+def test_list_tasks_small_limit_unchanged():
+    tasks = [_task(i) for i in range(1, 11)]
+    client = FakeClient(tasks)
+    rows = list_items(client, "tasks", limit=3)
+    assert [r["id"] for r in rows] == [10, 9, 8]
+
+
+def test_list_tasks_empty_store():
+    client = FakeClient([])
+    assert list_items(client, "tasks", limit=1000) == []

sidecar.summary: Fixed task listing to paginate past the API's 500-item cap by repeatedly fetching with before_id until the requested limit is satisfied.
